context.transcript:
I'd like to update the management team on the new fruit drink that our product developers have been working on.
There are two different recipes we're considering, one using sugar and the other using honey as a sweetener.
But we're not sure which recipe to use in production.
The one using honey would cost more, but it has a very special flavor.
The marketing department will conduct some research with a focus group to find out which drink recipe customers prefer.
This research will be conducted next week, and then we'll have the information we need to make a decision.

我想向管理团队汇报一下我们的产品开发人员正在研究的新果汁饮品。
我们正在考虑两种不同的配方，一种使用糖，另一种使用蜂蜜作为甜味剂。
但我们不确定应该在生产中使用哪种配方。
用蜂蜜的成本会更高，但它有一种非常特别的味道。
市场部将与焦点小组进行一些研究，以了解客户更喜欢哪种饮品配方。
这项研究将在下周进行，然后我们将获得做出决策所需的资料。
